title: Privathaftpflicht tariff offer overlay (structured, non-LLM)
description: User-supplied facts that are NOT in the AVB/PIB and that extraction correctly leaves null: the premium, the chosen Versicherungs-/Deckungssumme, the chosen Selbstbeteiligung and (where a tariff grades them) the chosen service level per module. Source: a check24 result row, a personal Angebot, or a Leistungsuebersicht. scripts/overlay.py validates each data/privathaftpflicht/offers/<key>.json against this, then merges it onto the pure record out/privathaftpflicht/tariffs/<key>.json into out/privathaftpflicht/enriched/<key>.json. No model touches this path; every value is copied verbatim.

quelle.description: Provenance label, e.g. 'check24-Ergebnisliste 2026-06-23' or 'Persoenliches Angebot ARAG 2026-06'. overlay copies this into beitrag.quelle.

doctype.description: Provenance doctype for the appended sources entry (default 'angebot').

beitrag.description: Premium. Give monatlich_eur (check24 default) and/or jaehrlich_eur; overlay derives the monthly figure from the annual one if only the latter is present.

modules.description: Chosen service level per module, for tariffs that grade them. overlay refuses a level on a module the tariff record does not mark included. Module keys mirror schema/privathaftpflicht/tariff.schema.json.

coverage.description: Chosen coverage values the AVB lists only as selectable options.

versicherungssumme.description: Chosen Deckungssumme, e.g. '5 Mio EUR' — the personally selected cover, not an AVB fact.

level.description: Chosen variant; mirrors tariff.schema module.level (null not allowed here — omit the module to leave it unset).
